requiredFindings.title: ExistingOnly and the install gate are given one new-process rule
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The r6 role-standing paragraph says both admitted standings withhold only starting a new process, which needs EV-INSTALL, and that starting a new process is withheld under both through GRANT.*. role_machine::continuation returns ExistingOnly when the core and component are Trusted and the index is Expired or StaleRevocation: an existing verified process, and never a new-process grant. It returns InstallGateRequiredForNewProcess when the three roles are otherwise past the refuse cases: continuing is permitted, and starting still needs EV-INSTALL. The Continue event is accepted for both, and the standing does not change when EV-INSTALL is admitted. One withhold under both opens a gate ExistingOnly does not have, and it keeps withholding a new process after the install gate has been satisfied. The M2 writer allowance and the Continuation::Refuse split are right and stay. Required: from an ExistingOnly view the repository-execution grant never admits a new process, on an existing GRANT.* detail. From an InstallGateRequiredForNewProcess view a new process is withheld until EV-INSTALL is admitted and is granted once that event is admitted; a withhold before that event is an existing GRANT.* detail. Neither case publishes X4T item 10's continuation row. Every M2 writer effect stays allowed under both.

scope: Law X4 r6. r5 RF-1 is closed. r5 RF-2's continuation-row half is closed. RF-1: the two admitted standings share one new-process withhold. No product cargo.
